topic: tokenomics investor documentation data rooms 2026 venture capital due diligence requirements
summary: In 2026, venture capital due diligence for Web3 tokenomics mandates comprehensive investor data rooms with financial models, vesting schedules, sell pressure analysis, Monte Carlo simulations, and compliance packs. Standards emphasize post-TGE unlock visuals, scenario modeling, and red-flag checks to assess sustainability, with exchanges and VCs requiring audits, legal opinions, and liquidity planning for listings.

keyFacts: Tokenomics data rooms must include token design artifacts, financial models with Monte Carlo simulations, vesting schedules, and unlock visuals[1]
Investor-grade models require 60-month cumulative unlock schedules, monthly sell pressure, volume absorption ratios, and overhang windows at 30/90/180/365 days[2]
Exchange data rooms need smart contract audits, legal opinions, tokenomics packs, team governance, and traction metrics[3]
VC due diligence emphasizes scenario modeling (base/bear/bull), concentration analysis, and wallet distribution transparency[3][6]
Vesting schedules should extend over multiple years to align incentives, with significant allocations for community and ecosystem[6]
Post-TGE layers like liquidity depth and red-flag checks determine project survival[2]
Compliance-first architecture is essential, treating token launches like regulated financial product rollouts[3]
